description: This PHP source file defines a class 'postscript_tables_core_999450' that extends 'script_tables_core_parent'. It contains methods for executing constructive and destructive database schema changes, including logging and verification of table renaming operations within the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: postscript_tables_core_999450
classes.description: A class for managing specific database schema changes with logging and verification, extending 'script_tables_core_parent'.

methods.name: execute_constructive
methods.description: Performs constructive database operations, initializes parameters, logs start, and calls '_logActualConstructive'.

methods.name: execute_destructive
methods.description: Performs destructive database operations, initializes parameters, logs start, and calls '_logActualDestructive'.

methods.name: _logActualConstructive
methods.description: Logs details about the addition of the 'klapaucius' table during constructive changes.

methods.name: _logActualDestructive
